name: RealVideoQuest
description: RealVideoQuest is a benchmark designed to evaluate text-to-video models on their ability to generate video responses to real-world, visually grounded user queries. It contains real user queries with video response intents and high-quality query-video pairs, assessed via a multi-angle evaluation system.
reputation: A relatively new but notable benchmark for real-world text-to-video generation, with growing interest due to its grounded query-video pairing and human evaluation protocol.
notes: Focuses on real user queries with video intents; uses multi-stage video retrieval and refinement.
